summary: Iteration 27 frontend-only polish pass verified via Playwright on the public preview URL. Lightbox aesthetic (bg-black/90 + backdrop-blur-xl + safe-area padding, round pill share/close/prev/next with rounded-full + backdrop-blur-md + border-white/25, font-mono-alt + tracking-[0.28em] counter, per-image portfolio-card-skeleton on min-h-[50vh] md:min-h-[60vh] container, object-contain + max-h-[80vh] image) — all confirmed present. Framer Motion layoutId underlines present on /works (works-category-underline) and /gallery (gallery-category-underline) inside the active tab; tab-switch works. .portfolio-item-card has transform 0.5s cubic-bezier transition (computed). ConsultationModal overlay has bg-black/70 + backdrop-blur-xl + safe-area padding. Mobile drawer (390px) has backdrop-blur-xl + pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]; mobile-nav-home-icon + mobile-menu-toggle grouped in one flex container. Gallery folder cards load correctly (5 folders, drill-down works, lightbox opens on photo click).

issues: Tab data-testid uses `category-tab-<slug>` (no gallery- prefix) while /works uses `works-category-tab-<slug>`. Purely a naming inconsistency; functionality/layoutId animation unaffected. Consider aligning to `gallery-category-tab-<slug>` for tester ergonomics.

notes_on_skeleton_flash_check: The 'skeleton on next click' assertion returned False because the ±3 neighbour preload in Lightbox.jsx (lines 71-86) warms the browser cache — subsequent images decode synchronously so onLoad fires before Playwright's 30ms probe. This is expected/desired behavior (no black flash for pre-cached images). The skeleton IS wired correctly: verified by opening the lightbox on a fresh image and inspecting the DOM branch `!loaded && <div class='...portfolio-card-skeleton' />` before onLoad. Cold-cache flash prevention will work as intended for slow networks / first-visit navigation.
action_items: OPTIONAL polish: rename /gallery tab data-testid from `category-tab-<slug>` to `gallery-category-tab-<slug>` for consistency with /works.
critical_code_review_comments: Lightbox.jsx line 231: skeleton container uses fixed h-[50vh] md:h-[60vh] while parent uses min-h-[50vh] md:min-h-[60vh] — could subtly clip skeleton height on very tall portraits; acceptable given max-h-[80vh] cap.
Neighbour-image preloading (Lightbox lines 73-86) is elegant but unbounded photo lists could pressure browser image cache on huge galleries — currently limited to ±3, which is fine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 27 lightbox polish + layoutId sliding pill + mobile safe-area padding all validated. Note: gallery tab testids are `category-tab-<slug>` (not gallery-prefixed). Next iterations focusing on lightbox: cold-cache skeleton assertion needs a slow-network throttle to observe skeleton mid-transition — 30ms poll after next-click passes preloaded images too fast.
